name: Wine
description: A wine bottle in a user's WineKeeper collection.

region.description: Wine region (e.g. Napa Valley, Bordeaux, Tuscany)

style.description: Style or color category of the wine

drink_window_start.description: Start of the recommended drinking window

drink_window_end.description: End of the recommended drinking window

storage_location_id.description: Foreign key to a StorageLocation record

estimated_value.description: Legacy estimated per-bottle value (kept for compatibility)

estimated_total_value.description: Current estimated total value for all bottles in inventory

replacement_cost_estimate.description: Estimated replacement cost for this record

valuation_confidence.description: Confidence level for current valuation data

valuation_updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when valuation data was last updated

manual_valuation_enabled.description: When true, manual_estimated_value takes priority over derived valuation

manual_estimated_value.description: Manual per-bottle override value used when manual valuation is enabled

market_estimated_unit_value.description: System-derived market per-bottle estimate from enrichment

market_estimated_total_value.description: System-derived total market value estimate for current quantity

market_replacement_cost_estimate.description: System-derived replacement estimate for the full baseline quantity

market_valuation_confidence.description: Confidence level of system-derived market valuation

market_valuation_updated_at.description: ISO timestamp when market valuation was last refreshed by the system

notes.description: Free-text personal notes about this wine

is_favorite.description: Whether this wine is marked as a favorite

ai_excluded.description: Whether this wine is excluded from AI recommendations

created_by.description: Email of the user who created this record
